<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="y8p-GQ6z6ft1YbIDzbrh"> <mxGraphModel dx="1079" dy="777" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 class InvoiceController {
 +create(InvoiceRequest) InvoiceResponse
 +invoices(page, size) Page~InvoiceResponse~
 +getInvoice(invoiceId) InvoiceResponse
 +getInvoiceByStatus(status) Page~InvoiceResponse~
 +downloadInvoice(invoiceId) byte[]
 }
 class InvoiceService {
 <<interface>>
 +createInvoice(InvoiceRequest) InvoiceResponse
 +findByInvoiceStatus(page, size, status) Page~InvoiceResponse~
 +findAll(page, size, sortBy, orderedBy) Page~InvoiceResponse~
 +findInvoice(invoiceId) InvoiceResponse
 }
 class InvoiceServiceImpl
 class InvoicePdfService {
 <<interface>>
 +generateInvoice(invoiceId) byte[]
 }
 class InvoicePdfServiceImpl {
 -CompanyProperties companyProperties
 -InvoiceRepository invoiceRepository
 -PaymentRepository paymentRepository
 -InvoicePdfMapper invoicePdfMapper
 -PdfGenerator pdfGenerator
 }
 class InvoiceRepository {
 <<interface>>
 +findByInvoiceId(String) Optional~Invoice~
 }
 class Invoice {
 +String invoiceId
 +BigDecimal subTotal
 +BigDecimal tax
 +BigDecimal grandTotal
 +InvoiceStatus invoiceStatus
 +List~InvoiceItem~ invoiceItems
 +List~Payment~ payment
 +markPaid()
 +markCanceled()
 }
 class InvoiceItem {
 +String invoiceItemId
 +Product product
 +Integer quantity
 +BigDecimal unitPrice
 +BigDecimal lineTotal
 }
 class InvoiceStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 PENDING
 PAID
 CANCELED
 }

 InvoiceController --> InvoiceService
 InvoiceController --> InvoicePdfService : downloadInvoice()
 InvoiceService <|.. InvoiceServiceImpl
 InvoicePdfService <|.. InvoicePdfServiceImpl
 InvoiceServiceImpl --> InvoiceRepository
 InvoiceRepository --> Invoice
 Invoice \"1\" *-- \"many\" InvoiceItem
 Invoice --> InvoiceStatus",
 "config": null
